newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Bank Ekspor Impor Indonesia to set US$90 mln FRN.
newsitem.headline: Bank Ekspor Impor Indonesia to set US$90 mln FRN.

text.p: Indicative terms on the following issue were announced by DKB Asia. The notes will be offically launched in the week of Sepember 16.
BORROWER PT BANK EKSPOR IMPOR INDONESIA ACTING THROUGH ITS CAYMAN ISLANDS BRANCH
AMT US$90 MLN COUPON 6ML+62 MATURITY 7 YRS
TYPE FRN ISS PRICE PAR RE-OFFER 99.85
PUTS YR 5* CALLS YR 5** PAY DATE TBA
LISTING LUXEMBOURG REPAYMENT BULLET DENOMS($K) 500/100
RATINGS BAA3 LIMITS CUSTOMARY
NEG PLG NA CRS DEF NA FORCE MAJ IPMA2
GOV LAW ENGLISH HOME CTRY INDONESIA TAX PROV STANDARD
FEES NOT YET SET
LEADS DKB ASIA (ASIAN BOOKRUNNER EXCLUDING JAPAN, SIGNING,
PUBLICITY), FUJI INTERNATIONAL FINANCE HK (JAPANESE
BOOKRUNNER, DOCUMENTATION, AGENT), SOCIETE GENERALE
ASIA (US AND EUROPEAN BOOKRUNNER)
NOTES *CAN BE PUT AT PAR PLUS ACCRUED INTEREST IF INDONESIA
CEASES TO HOLD AT LEAST 51 PCT OF THE BORROWER.
**CAN BE CALLED AT PAR PLUS ACCRUED INTEREST AND ANY
ADDITIONAL AMOUNT IN THE EVENT OF DISPOSITION OF
WITHHOLDING TAXES IN INDONESIA AND CAYMAN ISLANDS.
***EUROCLEAR, CEDEL CLEARING
-- Hong Kong Newsroom (852) 2843-6371
